proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ μ _ ι _ A B hA hd hu hB _
  have hmul : ∀ i, (ProbabilityTheory.cond μ (A i)).real B * μ.real (A i) = μ.real (A i ∩ B) := by
    intro i
    simp only [MeasureTheory.Measure.real]
    rw [← ENNReal.toReal_mul, ProbabilityTheory.cond_mul_eq_inter (hA i) B μ]
  simp_rw [hmul]
  have hB' : (⋃ i, A i ∩ B) = B := by
    rw [← Set.iUnion_inter, hu, Set.univ_inter]
  have hsum : μ (⋃ i, A i ∩ B) = ∑' i, μ (A i ∩ B) :=
    MeasureTheory.measure_iUnion
      (fun i j hij => (hd hij).mono Set.inter_subset_left Set.inter_subset_left)
      (fun i => (hA i).inter hB)
  rw [hB', tsum_fintype] at hsum
  simp only [MeasureTheory.Measure.real]
  rw [hsum, ENNReal.toReal_sum (fun _ _ => MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top _ _)]
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] (A : ι → Set Ω) (B : Set Ω), (∀ i, MeasurableSet (A i)) → Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (A i) (A j)) → (⋃ i, A i) = Set.univ → MeasurableSet B → (∀ i, 0 < μ.real (A i)) → μ.real B = ∑ i, (ProbabilityTheory.cond μ (A i)).real B * μ.real (A i)
